import scipy.special as sp
def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+sp.erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
emap=json.load(open('expo_map.json'))
res={}
for l in range(9):
    k=emap[str(l)]
    Zp=np.load(f'pass_{k}/token_hidden_L{l+1}.npy'); msk=np.load(f'pass_{k}/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
    Z=Zp[msk].astype(np.float64); sent=np.repeat(np.arange(64)[:,None],Zp.shape[1],1)[msk]
    P=f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.'
    X=Z*base(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')+base(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')
    W1=base(P+'intermediate.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bb1=base(P+'intermediate.dense.bias')
    W2=base(P+'output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bb2=base(P+'output.dense.bias')
    A=gelu(X@W1.T+bb1); F=A@W2.T+bb2; S=X+F
    tr=sent%2==0; te=~tr
    Fden=np.linalg.norm(F[te]-F[te].mean(0))**2; Sden=np.linalg.norm(S[te]-S[te].mean(0))**2
    en=A[tr].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0)
    out=[]
    for m in [768,1024,1536,2048]:
        keep=np.sort(np.argsort(-en)[:m])
        As=A[:,keep]; mu=As[tr].mean(0); Fm=F[tr].mean(0); Ac=As[tr]-mu; Fc=F[tr]-Fm; W0=W2[:,keep].T
        G=Ac.T@Ac; R=Ac.T@Fc
        best=None
        for lam in [30,100,300]:
            Wn=np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.eye(m), R+lam*W0); b=Fm-mu@Wn
            e=np.linalg.norm(As[te]@Wn+b-F[te])**2
            if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,lam)
        out.append('%d:%.3f/%.4f(l%d)'%(m,best[0]/Fden,best[0]/Sden,best[1]))
    print(l, '|F|/|S| var ratio %.2f'%(Fden/Sden), ' '.join(out))
